label: Indexed compact-time operations are finite, by Mathlib compact local finiteness
meaning: Use Mathlib's locallyFinite.finite_nonempty_inter_compact with the singleton time set attached to each operation index and isCompact_Icc on the real interval. All indices whose timestamp lies in [a,b] also have singleton time sets meeting [a,b]. This derives finite indices with no injectivity of the time assignment. Its explicit conditional local-finiteness hypothesis is inside the universally quantified proposition.
